messages:
Mia Chen: heads up — acme-prod's console graphs are empty for ~45m. Private VPC deployment behind customer envoy. API calls succeed but console shows no usage. Screenshot: https://acme.example/screens/graphs-blank.png

Samir Patel: are they on Dedicated or Private? any recent ingress changes?

Mia Chen: private. Verified runtime sees requests; tokens accepted. Example curl we used:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'X-Redwood-Tenant: acme-prod' https://private.redwood.example/api/v1/usage/summary
```
Response 200 from runtime. But console still empty.

Jordan Rivera: can you paste a sample runtime access log line and the telemetry-forwarder log around the same request? Also check if the proxy is rewriting tenant headers.

Mia Chen: runtime log: `[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] req=id123 tenant=acme-prod model=gptj latency=120ms`
telemetry-forwarder.log: `WARN no tenant mapping for header 'tenant:acme-prod' -> dropping`

Lina Novak: that WARN is suspicious — shard mapping expects plain tenant id, but it looks like ingress is sending a legacy prefix `tenant:acme-prod`. If the forwarder does a strict lookup it will drop metrics. Did we recently change REDWOOD_TENANT_HEADER_MAP or proxy header templates?

Samir Patel: repro quickly:
- curl with `X-Redwood-Tenant: tenant:acme-prod` -> forwarder logs show drop
- curl with `X-Redwood-Tenant: acme-prod` -> forwarded OK
Can you run this against their ingress and capture response headers: `curl -I -H 'X-Redwood-Tenant: tenant:acme-prod' https://private.redwood.example/internal/telemetry/forward`

Mia Chen: returned headers: `x-telemetry-forward-status: dropped`, `x-tenant-id: tenant:acme-prod`. Attaching short raw logs.

Jordan Rivera: quick mitigation idea — add compatibility layer in telemetry-forwarder to strip `tenant:` prefix before shard lookup. Patch ready. Will run a canary deploy to staging then prod if green. Also add debug logging to capture raw incoming tenant headers for a short window.

Lina Novak: agree. Also check envoy config on customer side: they have a header_format rule that prepends `tenant:` for internal routing. We should update our docs and ingress receptor config so both variants map. Mark as P2 and notify CSM.

Mia Chen: customer impacted analytics only; billing unaffected. They asked for ETA — giving 30-45m.

ops-bot: deploy initiated by Jordan Rivera at 1960000500. Rolling restart telemetry-forwarder (canary 2/40).

Jordan Rivera: canary logs show telemetry entries accepted now; mapping normalized to `acme-prod`. Console ingestion spikes started returning data ~2m after canary.

Mia Chen: customer confirmed graphs repopulating. I'll send a short incident note.

Samir Patel: postmortem checklist: root cause (ingress header prefix mismatch), timeline, code change (strip prefix compatibility), ingress docs update, add unit/integration tests for header variants, alert on forwarder drop-rate >1%.

Lina Novak: created PM ticket INF-492 for follow-up, assigned to eng-telemetry. QA: add integration test that validates both `tenant:` prefixed and plain tenant headers.

Mia Chen: closing thread for now. Thanks all :tada:
